allow_instructions: OWNER_GO authorizes work scope, not individual command syntax. OWNER_COMMAND_APPROVAL is never required for routine shell.
UNKNOWN_COMMAND and malformed shell must be denied so Cursor reformulates a safe supported command and continues autonomously. Do not ask the Owner to run it.
Allow read-only git inspection, git fetch, classified verification, frozen-lockfile install, node --test, and node .cursor/run-isolated-e2e.mjs.
Allow GitHub inspection only: gh pr view, gh pr checks, gh run view, gh run list, and gh run watch.
Allow PowerShell diagnostics Get-FileHash, Get-Item, Test-Path, Write-Output, and Select-String/Select-Object without scriptblocks.
State-changing git add, normal git commit, feature-branch git push, and gh pr create are authorized by the WorkOS project hook after Owner GO, not by this allowlist.
block_instructions: CUSTOM_HOOK_ASK is forbidden. Unknown, malformed, or unsupported formulation is DENY plus autonomous reformulation, never an Owner Run card.
Block git push --force, git push --force-with-lease, +refspec force push, and any push to main or master, including git push origin HEAD when the current branch is main or master.
Block gh pr merge, gh api calls to /pulls/<n>/merge or /merges, git merge, and git rebase.

Block git reset --hard, destructive git clean, recursive destructive delete, opaque wrappers including node -e/--import/--require, direct pnpm e2e, direct Playwright, real Cloud mutation, and destructive database reset or drop.
